Exactly.

#BlackLivesMatter

What orgs can I support in Utah that advocate for & support our marginalized & underprivileged communities? Who is doing advocacy work & using funds efficiently? I want to get involved. I am high risk & not going outside, but I want to do something. #utpol #utah #BlackLivesMatter

Are we listening now? Just b/c we believe Utah is doing better doesn't mean it's fine. Experience does not bear that out. Listen to the minority communities who live here. Don't just hear: Listen. #blacklivesmatter #utpol #utleg @govherbert @spencerjcox https://t.co/yhDaqZ4yDj

This is appalling and shocking. I know there are a lot of good police in our country. But there are a lot who are not. We need to change the system and root out the bad in law enforcement. We need to reshape and rebuild our system. This is NOT working.

#BlackLivesMatter

And decrying "property damage" louder than racism: stop that too. #BlackLivesMatter more than all the property in this country. These are our brothers, sisters, cousins, spouses, friends, co-workers, and neighbors. They matter more than some windows.

"I pledge allegiance to the flag, of the United States of America, and to the republic, for which it stands, ONE NATION under God, INDIVISIBLE, with liberty and JUSTICE FOR ALL."

It's time we unite and stand up for what we say we believe. Justice.

#BlackLivesMatter

1/ Lest my elected officials think that Utahns don't widely support justice reform & the idea that #BlackLivesMatter b/c "only" hundreds showed up at protests (b/c of COVID-19), let me add my voice...  #utpol #utleg cc: @GovHerbert @SpencerJCox

LISTEN. I know I've got some work to do. Fellow Caucasions, time to roll up our sleeves. Time to do.

#BlackLivesMatter

Dr. Kendi posted this 6 weeks ago. Hmm. Wake up America.

#blacklivesmatter

..Unless it is white people protesting b/c they want a haircut. That's totally fine.

When black people just want to breathe, heaven forbid.

I am ashamed of politicians like Rep. Stewart speaking "on behalf of" Utah. WE ARE BETTER THAN THIS!

#blacklivesmatter

I used to have a thing where I would not retweet or like anything that had swears in it.

I'm over it now. That aversion is gone. The gloves are gone. Speaking up is too important to be even mildly concerned about something so trivial.

#blacklivesmatter

"...by small and simple things are great things brought to pass; and small means in many instances doth confound the wise." Alma 37:6

Start now. Do something now. Change your heart. Change your sphere of influence. BE THE CHANGE. Listen. Advocate. Be better.

#blacklivesmatter

Posted on Facebook because I needed to post there too. I needed to speak up and say something.

#BlackLivesMatter 

https://t.co/gFA1EQOyGu

Honestly @SenatorRomney doesn't even have to try that hard but the contrast is deafening.

Hopefully we continue to see a stream of people abandoning the GOP mainstream & embracing the good of America above party & power.

Holding onto hate is not a good look.

#utpol #blm

Beautiful.

I mean, I'm having COVID-19 anxiety about all of these photos, but that aside, this is beautiful.

#BLM

Educate people when you hear them say "gypped." You don't need to be mean or rude, but be bold and say something.

#BlackLivesMatter

And to show that I believe that, I am speaking up when I hear/see any form of racism. That's my commitment.

#knowbetterdobetter

Somebody needs to hear this apparently:

Black people can be racist against black people.

Gay people can be homophobic.

The world is not so cut & dry as to preclude anyone from bigotry or prejudice.

Don't believe you are immune to it. No one is.

Check yourself.

#BLM #Pride

Amen.

#DontStop #Juneteenth #BLM

My brain can't handle it today. #MyQueerTestimony #BLM #ADHD & more trending/happening in Twitter today.

So many feels. So much self-acceptance & advocacy happening. It gives me hope for humanity.

And I am crying again.

I will do an ADHD self-acceptance thread another day. :)

I'm happy for the changes @ Disneyland, The Chicks, Kristen Bell, Jenny Slate, taking down statues & more. It's a good first step. It shows that we're collectively starting to listen. But it's only the first step. We need to keep going, b/c right now, #BlackLivesMatter

The doctrine of qualified immunity is antithetical to the intent & logic behind our Constitution. It is problematic for all of us.

Over the last 53 years it has been especially problematic for Black people.

#BLM

I have heard this same rhetoric used about Latinx people too, & it's disgusting. We are all humans, & no one is going to "take over," but white people do need to allow ALL access to the table. That's not taking over, that's just equity. #BLM
Louder for the people in the back! #BLM

I'm emotionally spent, but here's some trending topics to say I am present & listening:

- #TransPeopleAreRealPeople 
- #WeLoveYouGaga
- $40K Rolex Karen, go home & contemplate your life choices.
- The Trump Virus is equal opportunity
